text: 2026年的暑期，小城慢游受到青睐 2026 年暑期国内文旅市场整体稳健向好，呈现出亲子研学主流化、县域慢游潮流化、“赛事文娱 + 旅游”体验式消费爆发以及消费券精准拉动等多重亮点。
text_en: In summer 2026, slow-paced small-city travel gains favor; the domestic cultural and tourism market shows steady improvement overall, featuring highlights such as mainstream parent-child study tours, trendy county-level slow travel, an explosion in experience-based consumption from 'events and entertainment plus tourism,' and precise stimulus from consumption vouchers.
